data.name: Bloody Detective`s Last Case
data.detailed_description:
Bloody Detective’s Last Case is a fast-paced boomer shooter where style, aggression, and positioning matter more than cover.

You are Chad Chadson, a no-nonsense detective on his final case. A case that leads straight into a nightmarish tower run by a magical cartel — where reality bends, the dead don’t stay dead, and blood is more than just a stain.

Armed with a heavy-hitting revolver, a devastating rocket launcher, and rapid-fire weaponry, you’ll carve your way through hordes of twisted enemies using both firepower and blood magic.

Your signature tool? A Blood Beacon — throw it, fight, then snap back instantly, healing yourself and repositioning mid-combat. It’s not just mobility — it’s survival.

The closer you get to the tower, the more the world unravels: quiet suburbs twist into impossible geometry, floating structures, and surreal nightmares.

This is your last case.
And it’s going to get bloody.

Key features

 High-Speed Arena Combat
Tight, aggressive gunplay with constant movement, rocket jumps, and no room to hide.

 Blood Magic Mobility
Master the Blood Beacon: teleport, outplay enemies, and recover in the middle of chaos.

 Classic Arsenal, Modern Flow
Revolver, rocket launcher, and automatic weapons — each built for maximum impact and synergy with movement.

 Twisted Enemy Design
Face hordes of deranged undead — from fast, swarming attackers to slow, devastating threats.

 Surreal World Evolution
Explore environments that shift from grounded industrial outskirts to full-blown psychedelic nightmare.

Environmental Interaction
Solve combat-driven challenges: pressure buttons, beacon-based triggers, platforming, and deadly hazards.

data.short_description: Rip and tear… detective style. Play as Chad Chadson, a hard-boiled detective with a chiseled jaw and a blood-fueled arsenal on his final case against a twisted magical cartel. Master brutal gunplay, blood magic teleportation, and high-speed arena combat in a surreal world falling apart.

  • Processor: Intel i5-12400F/AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080/Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • VR Support: -

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-13400F/Ryzen 5 7600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3060
  • VR Support: -
